content_sections.heading: BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Important Dates
content_sections.text: This is a walk-in interview; there is no separate online application window mentioned in the notification. Eligible candidates must report directly to the venue on any of the specified dates with the required original documents.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 305 vacancies are available across 10 ITI trades at BHEL's Boiler Auxiliaries Plant, Ranipet. Note: The notification does not provide a category-wise (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS) breakup of these 305 vacancies; only the trade-wise numbers shown above are specified.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Eligibility Criteria / Qualification
content_sections.text: The qualification required for all trades under this recruitment is ITI (Industrial Training Institute) in the relevant trade. Candidates attending the walk-in interview must bring the following documents: VIII or X Standard Marksheets National Trade Certificate with Marksheets/Hall Tickets - for candidates whose Final Exams were in June 2026 and whose result is awaited, the Hall Ticket is acceptable in place of the certificate Aadhaar Card Community Certificate (OBC/SC/ST/EWS), if applicable Disability Certificate, in case of PwD candidates The notification does not specify a minimum percentage of marks or any other qualifying criteria beyond possession of the ITI qualification and the documents listed above.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit for this recruitment is not specified in the notification. Candidates should refer to the official Apprentices Act, 1961 guidelines or contact BHEL Ranipet directly (contact details below) for any age-related eligibility clarification. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the notification. Since this is a walk-in interview and not an online application process, there is no application/registration fee to be paid - eligible candidates simply need to report to the venue in person with the required documents.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Stipend
content_sections.text: The engagement is for a period of 01 year , under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is conducted through a Walk-in Interview at BHEL, Boiler Auxiliaries Plant, Ranipet. Interested and eligible candidates must report in person at the venue on any of the specified dates, along with all the original documents listed in the eligibility section, for document verification and interview. The notification does not provide further details of a separate written test or additional selection stages beyond the walk-in interview and document verification.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Walk-in Interview Details
content_sections.text: There is no online application process for this recruitment. Interested and eligible candidates should directly attend the walk-in interview as per the details below. Check that you hold the ITI qualification in one of the eligible trades (Fitter, Welder, Turner, MMV, Plumber, Electrician, Refrigerator & AC Mechanic, Carpenter, Machinist/OAMT, or Instrument Mechanic). Gather all required original documents: VIII or X Standard Marksheets, National Trade Certificate with Marksheets/Hall Tickets (Hall Ticket accepted only for June 2026 result-awaited candidates), Aadhaar Card, Community Certificate (if applicable), and Disability Certificate (if applicable, for PwD candidates). Report to the HRM Conference Hall, Admin. Building, BHEL, Ranipet – 632406, on any date between 18th and 21st August 2026, from 09:00 Hrs onwards. Carry your documents for verification at the venue.

faq.question: Q1. What is BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in interview conducted by Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL), Boiler Auxiliaries Plant, Ranipet, for the engagement of 305 Trade Apprentices across 10 ITI trades, for a period of 01 year under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 305 vacancies: Fitter-135, Welder-90, Turner-20, MMV-03, Plumber-03, Electrician-23, Refrigerator & AC Mechanic-03, Carpenter-03, Machinist/OAMT-21, and Instrument Mechanic-04.

faq.question: Q3. When is the BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held from 18th to 21st August 2026, starting at 09:00 Hrs each day, at the HRM Conference Hall, Admin. Building, BHEL, Ranipet – 632406.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an ITI qualification in the relevant trade.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned; since this is a walk-in interview, there is no online application process or fee involved.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application. Eligible candidates should directly attend the walk-in interview at the venue mentioned above, between 18th and 21st August 2026, with the required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview and document verification at the venue; the notification does not specify any additional written test stage.

faq.question: Q8. What is the stipend for BHEL Ranipet Trade Apprentice?
faq.answer: ₹12,000 per month, along with subsidized canteen food, for the 1-year engagement period.
